official_identity: The Indian Health Service Fort Belknap Service Unit page identifies a six-bed critical access hospital at the Fort Belknap Agency in Harlem, Montana and states that services are administered by Indian Health Service.

cms_record.facility_name: P H S INDIAN HOSPITAL-FT BELKNAP AT HARLEM - CAH

regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30 deems federally owned or operated hospitals, including hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, in compliance with Part 180.
interpretation: CMS ownership and current IHS facility evidence identify this CCN as a federally operated Indian Health Program hospital within the federal scope disposition. This is not a claim about MRF availability or file quality.
next_action: Retain the federal scope exclusion unless CMS ownership or regulatory scope changes.
